story.titleZh: Edd Straw发布2026年拉斯维加斯大奖赛车手排名
story.summaryZh: Edd Straw在新的排名体系中评价了拉斯维加斯大奖赛中表现最佳和最差的车手，维斯塔潘在比赛中表现出色。
story.originalTitle: Edd Straw's F1 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix driver rankings
detailZh: 谁在F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛的疯狂超车盛宴中表现最好（和最差）？
这是Edd Straw在他的新等级排名驾驶员格式中的判断。
通常，您可以通过在The Race Members' Club的这篇帖子下评论来询问Edd的排名 - 并尝试使用我们方便的视觉工具编制自己的巴西大奖赛等级列表！
马克斯·维斯塔潘在排位赛中表现出色，尽管他只因为基米·安东内利的处罚而继承了杆位，但他最初的结果落后只是因为梅赛德斯车手的巨大牵引。
但真正让维斯塔潘脱颖而出的是这场比赛：他领先超过90%的比赛距离，当其他人展示出事情如何轻易失控时，他从未看起来会失去比赛。
这个级别包括了三位在卡洛斯·塞恩斯、皮埃尔·加斯利和兰多·诺里斯中发挥最好的车手。
尽管奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂的排位赛表现没有麦克拉伦队友诺里斯那么出色，但在比赛中仅落后他一步，完成了领奖台，而且在从第17位发车后需要从罚站中恢复过来，这帮助他进入了这个级别。
威廉姆斯车队第八名完成者塞恩斯也克服了罚站，在第一圈就锁定了位置，并在整个比赛中在积分圈内徘徊，是唯一一位来自最快六支车队之外的车手得分。这与加斯利在保持在与更快车队同一组中取得第五名，为阿尔派赢得一个强劲的位置相似。
弗朗哥·科拉平托与他的最佳大奖赛成绩持平，以第六名的成绩结束了一场精彩的比赛，但他在资格赛和比赛中缺乏他的阿尔卑斯车队队友的优势，不得不坐在加斯利的下面。
奥利·贝尔曼从最后一排的处罚中恢复过来，以大约13名的成绩结束，足够高的成绩，足以让哈斯车队保持第七名的车队积分。
对于刘易斯·汉密尔顿和伊萨克·哈迪亚尔来说，他们的周末因为一系列不幸和处罚而受到影响，这些处罚并不是明显的错误，但必须计入他们的账上。
考虑到汉密尔顿在比赛中携带地板损坏，他的资格赛表现得很出色，在被法拉利车队的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔推入旋转之前，他表现得很出色。然而，他之前因为离开赛道获得优势而被处以10秒处罚是可避免的，如果他只是合理地切角以防止碰撞，并归还位置的话。
至于哈达尔，他本来有机会赢得胜利，但在安全车阶段他的后备策略表现不佳，这意味着即使他没有前翼问题并赢得了比赛——他至少能进入前三——他也会因为被罚10秒而失去这个结果。
利亚姆·劳森在第八位顺利完成了资格赛，但比他的小红牛车队队友阿维德·林德布拉德落后两位，由于燃油泄漏导致他损失了一圈，他失去了在比赛中大放异彩的机会。即使安全车出动并帮他追回了一圈，他也没有时间重新加入车队，所以在那种情况下，从14位起步追回一些位置，虽然徒劳，但也是一种不错的表现。
奥迪车手们都度过了一个稳固的周末，加布里埃尔·博尔特洛托的情况尤其糟糕，但如果有车手能匹配萨因斯的比赛驾驶质量，也许会有一些积分机会，这将为博尔特洛托和尼科·胡肯伯格赢得中等水平的成绩。
至于费尔南多·阿隆索，那辆无望的阿斯顿·马丁给他提供的帮助很少，这使得很难公平地评价他，但考虑到他还有额外的动力单元问题，他至少有一个不错的周末。
拉斐尔·卡马拉被纳入这个小组，因为他虽然落后于哈斯车队的队友贝尔曼的速度，在缺乏经验和被塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯撞墙的情况下，他仍然完成了专业的工作。
兰斯·斯特罗尔和瓦尔特里·博塔斯都有足够的速度，但周末的表现并不突出，他们的速度不如队友快，但他们避免了犯下任何重大错误。这意味着他们因为不尽人意的但还算胜任的周末而在这个小组中。
安东内利的案例中，他因为在一个关键时刻的失误而滑入这个小组。虽然这是对规则的挫败，但他需要意识到这一点，这让他失去了胜利的机会。
他获得了杆位，但他承认，他的超级拖车更多是偶然而非有意策略，因为他在被迫进攻后，没有那个的话，他的排位赛速度并不特别出色。
亚历克斯·阿隆索是这个小组中不幸的车手，因为在排位赛中缺少拖车，加上刹车问题，他没有任何机会开始比赛。
这三个人在比赛中都犯了重大错误，这影响了他们的成绩，对于佩雷斯来说，他因此在下一次比赛中被处以五位的发车位置罚分。
乔治·拉塞尔速度快，他在比赛中大部分时间都在和维斯塔潘交换位置，试图找出如何进行最后的冲刺，但他从未到达那里，因为他滑到了队友安东内利的后面，然后在5号弯道犯了错误，最终撞到了墙上。因此，他以第九名的成绩完成了本可以赢得的比赛。
勒克莱尔在需要与法拉利队友合作时攻击汉密尔顿的愚蠢行为，加上尽管有下压力优势，他在排位赛中的表现似乎比汉密尔顿更差，这使得这个周末成为了一个难忘的周末。
林德布拉德在拉斯维加斯的比赛中表现相当出色，但被安全车卷入并因此错失重大胜利，这显然是一个新手犯的错误，它抵消了他之前所有的出色表现。虽然他提到了换挡问题，但最终这必须归咎于他的失误。
detailEn: Who actually did the best (and worst) job in Formula 1’s wild overtaking-fest Las Vegas Grand Prix?
Here’s Edd Straw’s judgement in his new tier list driver rankings format.

As usual, you can ask your questions about Edd's rankings by commenting on this post in The Race Members' Club - and have a crack at compiling your own Brazilian GP tier list with our handy visual tool!

Max Verstappen excelled in qualifying, as even though he only inherited pole position thanks to Kimi Antonelli’s penalty he was only behind in the initial results because of the Mercedes driver’s monster tow.
But it was the race that really marked Verstappen out: leading over 90% of it by distance and never looking like losing it when others showed how easy it was for things to unravel.
This tier includes a trio of drivers who got the most out of the race in Carlos Sainz, Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris.

And while Oscar Piastri’s qualifying performance wasn’t as sharp as McLaren team-mate Norris’s, finishing just behind him in the race as they completed the podium, the added complication of having to recover from 17th on the grid after a grid penalty helps to elevate him into this tier.

Williams’s eighth-place finisher Sainz also recovered from a penalty and after nailing the first lap, he spent the whole race in and around the points and was the only driver to score from outside the fastest half-dozen teams. That was similar to Gasly’s achievement in hanging in the group of quicker cars to bag a strong fifth place for Alpine.

Franco Colapinto matched his best grand prix result with sixth, driving a good race to cap a strong weekend, but has to sit a tier below Gasly as he lacked his Alpine team-mate’s edge in qualifying and the race.

Ollie Bearman recovered from a back-of-the-grid penalty to finish about as high as a Haas could have done in 13th, doing enough to trouble the Audi drivers to protect his team’s seventh place in the championship.
In the cases of Lewis Hamilton and Isack Hadjar, both had strong weekends undone by a mix of misfortune and penalties that weren’t overt errors but have to count against them.

Hamilton’s qualifying was well-executed given he carried floor damage and he raced well before being tipped into a spin by Ferrari team-mate Charles Leclerc, although the earlier 10-second penalty he was hit with for gaining an advantage by leaving the track was avoidable had he given the place back after justifiably cutting the corner to prevent a collision.

As for Hadjar, he was in the mix for victory but played the backing-up game poorly under the safety car, meaning even if he had not had the front wing problem and won the race - and he’d surely have been in the top three at least - he’d have lost the result to the 10-second penalty he was hit with.

Liam Lawson qualified decently in eighth, but that was two places behind Racing Bulls team-mate Arvid Lindblad, and he was denied the chance to make a big impact in the race by the fuel leak that cost him a lap. Even when the safety car was deployed and he got that lap back, he didn’t have time to rejoin the pack, so in that context making up some places to finish 14th represented a good, if fruitless, drive.

The Audi drivers both had solid weekends, Gabriel Bortoleto’s particularly blighted by problems, but there was perhaps a minor points opportunity had the drivers matched Sainz’s quality of race drive, earning both Bortoleto and Nico Hulkenberg a middling tier.

As for Fernando Alonso, the hopeless Aston Martin gave him little to work with and makes it difficult to evaluate him fairly, but he at least had a decent weekend given the additional power unit problems he had.

Rafael Camara is included in the group as while he was off Haas team-mate Bearman’s pace, in the circumstances of his lack of experience and being booted into the wall by Sergio Perez, he did a professional job.

Lance Stroll and Valtteri Bottas both had adequate but unremarkable weekends with their underlying pace not as sharp as their team-mates’, but they avoided making any significant errors. That means they are in this group for underwhelming, but competent, weekends.

In Antonelli’s case, he slips into this group because of the misjudgement he made in lifting at a key moment. While that’s a frustrating negative of the regulations, it was something he needed to be aware of and cost him a shot at victory.

He gets credit for pole position but he admitted that his monster tow was as much happenstance as a deliberate strategy after he was forced to attack, and without that his qualifying pace was nothing extraordinary.
Alex Albon is the unfortunate driver in this group with the lack of a tow in qualifying and no chance to start the race thanks to brake problems.
This trio all made significant errors in the race, which compromised their results and, in the case of Perez, earned him a five-place grid penalty for the next race.

George Russell was quick and spent a good part of the race swapping places with Verstappen and trying to work out how to play the final shootout, but never made it there as he slipped behind his team-mate Antonelli then made the Turn 5 error that ended up with him in the wall. He finished ninth in a race he could have won for that reason.

Leclerc’s foolishness in attacking Hamilton when co-operation with his Ferrari team-mate was needed, combined with the fact he seemed to struggle more in qualifying than Hamilton despite a downforce advantage, made this a weekend to forget.

So much of what Lindblad did in Las Vegas was superb, but spinning under the safety car and throwing away a big result was a rookie error that undid all of the good work. While he referenced a bad shift, ultimately this has to go down as his blunder.
keyPointsZh: 维斯塔潘在排位赛中虽然因科米·安东内利的处罚而获得杆位，但他的表现仍然出色。
塞恩斯、加斯利和诺里斯在比赛中发挥出色。
皮亚斯特里在维修区处罚后从第17位发车，最终完成颁奖仪式，表现突出。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen's performance in qualifying was exceptional despite inheriting pole position due to Kimi Antonelli's penalty.
Sainz, Gasly, and Norris made the most of the race.
Piastri recovered from a grid penalty to finish on the podium, starting from 17th on the grid.

detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：

detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.

国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
